name: openbb_equity_price_performance
description:
Price returns of one stock over standard windows (1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 and 6 months, YTD, 1 year and longer) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.price.performance).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp only; schema default fmp, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it).
Without a key, compute returns from yf_stock_history. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "provider": "fmp"}
